ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-09-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Bob Balian.
Petitioner: Phuong Thieu Du, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Mihn Trong Ha, was sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner/Minor's Father: Sinh Kim Ha, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change of the Minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Darren Ha.
Decree signed in open court.
